vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: aisa-financial-data-api
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides a client for the AIsa financial data API. It requires an `AISA_API_KEY` from environment variables, which is used to authenticate all network requests to the legitimate API endpoint `https://api.aisa.one`. The `SKILL.md` and `scripts/market_client.py` files contain no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, prompt injection attempts against the agent, or obfuscation. All actions are clearly aligned with the stated purpose of querying financial data.
